description: A tall, slender street lamp with a classic design, featuring a golden pole and a dual-light fixture at the top. The lamp heads are designed with transparent, possibly glass, covers, suggesting they house bulbs. The base of the lamp has a decorative, tiered structure, also in gold, and rests on a light grey circular platform. The overall aesthetic is simple and functional, suitable for illuminating outdoor spaces like streets, parks, or pathways. Its design appears to be a modern interpretation of traditional street lighting.
